title: Return Window
goal: Decide how the first Mars crew goes home.

return.home.title: HOME FOR DINNER
return.home.text: The ascent vehicle leaves Mars and the whole crew heads home. After a long trip, there is pizza and a very big hug waiting.

return.samples.title: ROCKS FROM MARS
return.samples.text: The crew carries home the first Martian rock cores. Scientists everywhere line up to peek at them.

return.scrape.title: WE MADE IT (BARELY)
return.scrape.text: The overloaded little rocket shakes the whole way, but it makes it. The crew is home, with plenty of stories and not much luggage.

return.keeper.title: KEEPER OF ARES
return.keeper.text: One brave volunteer stays to look after the outpost for the next crew. Earth waits, and Mars is no longer empty.
